title: Traditional Croatian Risotto
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian-inspired risotto dish. This recipe combines the creaminess of risotto with the spices of the Mediterranean region.

ingredients.name: Croatian joyful herb (such as parsley, thyme, or oregano)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with onion and garlic.
Add the white wine (if using) and stir until absorbed.
Add 1 cup of vegetable broth and stir until absorbed. Repeat this process, adding broth in 1/2 cup increments, and waiting for it to be absorbed before adding more.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the grated Parmesan cheese and joyful herb.
